author: opt-N10

contract.sync_assumed: all lanes of the hardware warp call the primitive together (the logical warps of a sub-warp instantiation run in lockstep)
contract.sync_performed: shuffles, ballots and one redux on the full warp mask, no barrier
contract.k_range: [1, N] with MaxK = max(LW, next_pow2(k)) dividing N and N / MaxK a power of two, the truncated merge applies to a power of two k (other k take the complete merge and a shuffle), k 4 to 64 measured
contract.n_range: N = LW x IPT with MaxK dividing N and N / MaxK a power of two, measured 32 to 256 at LW 32 and 8 to 128 at LW 4, 8, 16
contract.type_constraints: fp32 keys only, twiddled to an order-preserving u32 word (sign flip, -0.0 mapped to +0.0), the index is never carried through the network and is recovered from the item's position (slot i of lane l is source index i x LW + l) by ballot rank
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN twiddles above +inf (positive sign) or below -inf (negative sign) and is selected or dropped deterministically by its sign bit, never produced by focus-set inputs. -0.0 and +0.0 are one word
contract.tie_break_support: prefer_smaller_index exact by construction (items above the k-th word in index order, then the tied items in index order until k), the same code serves not_guaranteed at the same cost (within 0.04 percent in every measured pair of cells)
contract.sorted_output_support: not provided: the output is the selected set in class and index order (the complete-merge form N10_u32 has the sorted keys in position but places indices by rank, not by position)

correctness_notes: Batch 2 (umbriel-b200-020, one lease, seven consecutive run.py lock sections). Oracle battery (13 patterns, prefer_smaller_index checked exactly, including tie_heavy, pivot_tie, all_equal, signed_zero, inf_denorm) passed on every cell before any number. not_guaranteed and prefer_smaller_index are the same instantiation and measured within 0.04 percent of each other in every cell pair, the card lists both. Controls in the same lock section: N10_u32_trunc (sections s1 random and s2 tie patterns, prefer_smaller_index cells), W1_eager_same (section s4, both requirements).

low_level: The network is opt-W1's template recursion with the min and max exchange (T42) on the fp32 key twiddled to u32: 290 VIMNMX, 142 SHFL, 2 CREDUX.MIN, 16 VOTE on the fast path plus 16 on the tie path, 32 STS of which half on each path in the N 128 k 16 latency kernel (two network copies), no BSSY, no BRA beyond the harness's five, 0 stack, 0 STL, 0 LDL in every warp cell (T36 check). Registers 30 to 64 in the latency kernel (W1_eager_same 24 to 59), 23 to 32 in the throughput kernel (40 at N 256 k 64), occupancy 8 blocks per SM (6 at N 256 k 64, same as the control). One-ballot recovery: one VOTE.ANY per slot (8 back to back at IPT 8), the popc sum compared with k, then a BSSY, predicated BRA region with the fast path (one POPC, one LOP3, one IADD, one ISETP, one IMAD, one predicated STS per slot) and the two-class pass with IPT more VOTE on the other side, BSYNC. The region spans the whole call (BSSY at the kernel entry of the call), 2 BSSY and 2 BSYNC per latency kernel. Registers 32 to 72 in the latency kernel (54 at N 128, 72 at N 256), throughput kernel occupancy 8 blocks per SM up to N 128 and 6 at N 256 (the two-class form keeps 8 there).
algorithmic: Against the two-class recovery on the same network (N10_u32_trunc, same lock section), prefer_smaller_index latency, random input: N 32 k 4 569 against 504 and k 16 507 against 442 (plus 65), N 64 809, 747, 712 against 751, 696, 661 (plus 51 to 58), N 128 k 4, 16, 32 1085, 1053, 1018 against 1166, 1106, 1071 (minus 53 to 81), N 128 k 64 944 against 933, N 256 k 4, 16, 32 1893, 1862, 1829 against 2022, 1966, 1931 (minus 102 to 129), N 256 k 64 1453 against 1566. Throughput plus 1 to 11 percent up to N 128 (261 to 324 against 259 to 305), minus 5 percent at N 256 k 4 to 32 (272 to 276 against 286 to 291), plus 18 percent at N 256 k 64 (263 against 222).

Against the u64 word (W1_eager_same, section s4, both requirements): N 32 k 4 569 against 601 (0.95x), N 32 k 16 507 (0.84x), N 64 k 32 712 against 934 (0.76x), N 128 k 16 1053 against 1918 (0.55x), N 128 k 64 944 against 2216 (0.43x), N 256 k 16 1862 against 3826 (0.49x), N 256 k 64 1453 against 4650 (0.31x), throughput 1.41x to 2.0x.

Price of excess ties at rank k (section s2, patterns pivot_tie and all_equal, every item or nearly every item equal to the k-th word, against the branch-free two-class form measured on the same patterns): N 64 k 16 781 against 692, k 32 746 against 657, N 128 k 16 1149 against 1104, k 32 1108 against 1069, N 256 k 16 2126 against 1960, k 32 2092 against 1924. Relative to its own fast path on random input the tie path costs 34, 96 and 264 cycles at N 64, 128, 256 (5 to 14 percent). Random fp32 input never takes it (ties at rank k 1.0 in every measured cell).
negative: At IPT 1 and 2 the branch costs more than the ballots it saves: plus 51 to 65 cycles against the two-class form at N 32 and N 64. The one-ballot form belongs to IPT 4 and above (the combined adapter N10_auto switches there).
Throughput at N 256 k 4 to 32 drops 5 percent against the two-class form through the occupancy step from 8 to 6 blocks per SM (the tie path keeps IPT more ballot words live).
surprises: The reconvergence region does not hurt the network: ptxas keeps the fast path's eight ballots back to back and the measured gain at IPT 4 and 8 matches the saved ballots and popcs, while the T35 experience (a region per exchange) had suggested any BSSY in the call would cost more.
open_questions: Whether a branch-free one-ballot form exists: the fast path's rank is valid whenever the group holds exactly k words at least t, the tie case needs the above ballots, and no formulation was found that avoids either the second ballot set or the branch.
Whether the tie path can reuse the fast path's stores (write the fast-path slots speculatively, then fix only the tied items), which would make the tie cost the above ballots alone.
